problem.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
problem.notFound: Not found: it may have been removed.
problem.refused: The factory refused it as it stands now.
problem.invalid: Something in it does not read: check the fields.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a minute and try again.
problem.contract: The answer did not read as expected. Try again.
problem.unavailable: The factory did not answer. Check the connection and try again.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
problem.stale: Someone changed this case meanwhile: it was read again. Check it and try once more.
problem.duplicate: That record is linked to this case already.

held.right: Your role may not do this ({right}).
held.offline: Offline: it waits until the connection is back.
held.NO_PERMISSION: Your role may not do this.
held.CLOSED: The case is closed: it changes no more (open a new case).
held.NOT_NEW: The case is new: open it first.
held.NOT_FROM_HERE: The case cannot move there from where it is.
held.COVER_UNDECIDED: A warranty claim is resolved only once its cover is decided (the remedy follows from it).
held.NO_CUSTOMER: The case names no customer of ours: name the customer first.
held.NO_CONTACT_EMAIL: The case names no contact with an e-mail: the status mails go to the customer's contact.

hint.waitingCustomer: We wait for the customer's answer or goods
hint.waitingPart: We wait for a part to repair

notice.label: Notices
notice.unknownCover_one: {count} open case has no delivery day: its cover cannot be told until the day is typed.
notice.unknownCover_other: {count} open cases have no delivery day: their cover cannot be told until the day is typed.
notice.undecided_one: {count} warranty claim waits for its cover decision: it is resolved only once the cover is decided.
notice.undecided_other: {count} warranty claims wait for their cover decision: they are resolved only once the cover is decided.
notice.noCustomer_one: {count} open case names no customer of ours: a repair or a return needs one.
notice.noCustomer_other: {count} open cases name no customer of ours: a repair or a return needs one.
notice.partial: These notices count the first {count} cases read: Show more reads the rest.

list.intro: Warranty claims and service cases by garment or batch: which guarantee applies, said in words, and what the case opened.
list.termsLaterHint: Comes later: the warranty terms per product family.
list.noMatchBody: Clear a filter, or all of them.
list.emptyBody: No cases: a call, a mail or a visit about a garment becomes a case with New case.
list.foot: No amount on a case: a repair's cost and a credit's value are on their own records. Cause codes and the SLA come later.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to service cases
noAccess.body: Seeing service cases needs the right “See warranty and service cases”: the sales, quality, production and finance roles have it; an administrator can give it in Admin › Roles & permissions.

new.title: New case
new.subtitle: A call, a mail or a visit about a garment or a batch.
new.partyHint: A rider who is no customer of ours: leave it and name them in the words.
new.customersFailed: Couldn't read the customers: the case can still be made for a rider.
new.contactHint: Who wrote or called: the status mails go to them.
new.serialHint: A serial of ours fills the style, size and delivery day.
new.batchHint: When no serial is known: the work order's batch.
new.ownersFailed: Couldn't read who may own it: you own it.
new.previewFailed: Couldn't read what the serial gives: the case can still be made.
new.previewEmpty: Type or scan a serial, a batch or pick the customer: what we know about the garment and its guarantee shows here.
new.notOurs: {serial} is not a serial of ours: it is kept as typed.
new.batchFound_one: Batch {batch}: made in {workOrder}, {count} delivery to the customer.
new.batchFound_other: Batch {batch}: made in {workOrder}, {count} deliveries to the customer.
new.others_one: {count} other case is open for this garment: a duplicate?
new.others_other: {count} other cases are open for this garment: a duplicate?

suggested.LEGAL_GUARANTEE: The check points to the legal guarantee.
suggested.FACTORY_GUARANTEE: The check points to the factory guarantee.
suggested.NONE: The check points to out of cover.
suggested.unknown: The check cannot tell yet: the delivery day is not known.

scan.title: Scan the label
scan.intro: Hold the garment's label in front of the camera: the serial fills the field.
scan.noCamera: No camera here, or it is not allowed: type the serial instead.

garment.title: The garment
garment.notOurs: {label} is not a garment or batch of ours.
garment.none: No garment named: type its serial or batch on the form.
garment.photos: Photos: post them on the case's conversation (Activity).

form.title: Case
form.closedNoteOnly: The case is closed: only the internal note can still change.
form.partyLinked: Records of this customer are linked: unlink them to change the customer.
form.serialHint: A new serial of ours fills the style, size and delivery day again.
form.deliveredOnHint: Left empty: from our records (the shipment).
form.legalEndsHint: Left empty for a consumer: 2 years from delivery.
form.factoryEndsHint: From the terms the customer was given.
form.notifyLabel: Send a mail at each status change
form.notifyHint: To {to}, in their language (a test provider until the mail service is connected).
form.notifyNeedsEmail: Needs a contact with an e-mail.
form.internalNoteHint: Staff only: never in a mail to the customer.
form.offlineKept: Offline: your changes are kept on this page.

problem.problemNeeded: Say what is wrong, in the customer's words.
problem.oneLine: One line of at most {count} characters.
problem.deliveredFuture: The garment was delivered today or earlier.
problem.endBeforeDelivery: A guarantee ends on or after the delivery day.
problem.notifyNeedsEmail: The status mails need a contact with an e-mail.

check.deliveredOn: Delivered on {date}: the guarantees run from that day.
check.noDelivery: The delivery day is not known.
check.noDeliveryFix: Type the delivery day on the Case tab: the guarantees run from it.

buyer.CONSUMER: A consumer we sold to: the legal guarantee of conformity is ours to give.
buyer.BUSINESS: A business customer: the consumer's legal guarantee is not ours toward them; the contract and the Civil Code's warranty for defects apply.
buyer.NOT_NAMED: No customer of ours is named: a rider's legal guarantee is owed by the seller who sold them the garment.

legal.RUNS: Runs until {date}, 2 years from delivery (Directive (EU) 2019/771 art. 10; Codice del Consumo art. 133).
legal.UNKNOWN: A consumer: it runs 2 years from delivery; the delivery day is not known yet.
legal.NONE_BUSINESS: Not ours toward a business: the contract and art. 1490-1495 c.c.; a dealer who sold to a consumer may turn to us (right of redress, art. 18).
legal.NONE_NOT_NAMED: Owed by the seller who sold the garment, not by us.

presumption.applies: Within 1 year of delivery (until {date}): the defect is presumed to have existed at delivery; the customer need not prove it (art. 11; Codice del Consumo art. 135).
presumption.past: More than 1 year after delivery (since {date}): the customer shows the defect existed at delivery.
presumption.unknown: Within the first year after delivery a defect is presumed to have existed at delivery: the delivery day is not known yet.

factory.RUNS: Runs until {date}, on the factory's own terms, on top of any legal guarantee (art. 17).
factory.NONE: No factory guarantee is recorded for this garment.
factory.NONE_FIX: Type its last day on the Case tab, from the terms the customer was given.

remedies.LEGAL_GUARANTEE: Under the legal guarantee: a repair or a replacement free of charge, in a reasonable time; when neither is possible or it fails, a price reduction or the end of the contract (art. 13).
remedies.FACTORY_GUARANTEE: Under the factory guarantee: what its terms give (a repair, a replacement or a credit), on top of any legal guarantee and never in its place.
remedies.NONE: Out of cover: a repair or a replacement is a paid service or a courtesy; say why in the decision.
remedies.unknown: The remedies follow the cover: not known until the delivery day is.

liable.CONSUMER: We sold to this consumer: we answer to them as the seller, for the legal guarantee and for our own.
liable.BUSINESS: The seller answers to the consumer; our duty to this business is the contract's (and our own guarantee, when it runs).
liable.NOT_NAMED: The seller who sold the garment answers to the rider; we answer for our own guarantee.

warranty.title: Warranty check
warranty.intro: Which guarantee applies, and why: the remedies and who answers differ.
warranty.lawyer: The legal wording is the lawyer's to confirm.
warranty.notDecidedClaim: Not decided yet: decide the cover before the claim is resolved.
warranty.resolveNeedsCover: A warranty claim is resolved only once its cover is decided.

decide.title: Decide the cover of {number}
decide.subtitle: Covered, partly or not covered, under which guarantee, and why: one decision; deciding again replaces it.

coverHint.LEGAL_GUARANTEE: Needs the legal guarantee's last day (a consumer we sold to).
coverHint.FACTORY_GUARANTEE: Needs the factory guarantee's last day.
coverHint.NONE: Not covered: a paid service or a courtesy.

decide.noteHint: In words the customer can check (misuse, wear, a cause after delivery…).

problem.coveredNeedsGuarantee: Covered or partly covered: under the legal or the factory guarantee.
problem.notCoveredIsNone: Not covered: the cover is out of cover.
problem.noLegalEnd: The legal guarantee's last day is not known: type the delivery day (or the last day) on the Case tab first.
problem.noFactoryEnd: The factory guarantee's last day is not known: type it on the Case tab first.

warn.notConsumer: The customer of this case is not a consumer we sold to: the legal guarantee is the seller's toward the consumer (a dealer's redress).
warn.refuseWhileLegal: The legal guarantee runs until {date}: a refusal under it needs a reason the customer can check.

linked.emptyBody: Link an order, a shipment, a return, a repair, an invoice, a complaint or a work order, or open one from Actions.

via.RETURN: Return opened from the case: the goods come back
via.REMAKE: Return opened from the case for a remake
via.CREDIT: Return opened from the case for a credit

link.title: Link a record to {number}
link.subtitle: A record of the case's company and customer that you may see.
link.numberHint: Type part of its number and press Enter.
link.noteHint: One line: why it belongs to the case.

unlink.title: Unlink {what}?
unlink.body: {what} stays as it is; only its link to {number} goes.

actions.intro: What the case opens for {customer} and the garment {garment}: each record links back here.
actions.introNoCustomer: A repair or a return needs a customer of ours: name the customer on the Case tab first.
actions.later: An exchange and a visit come later.

repair.title: Repair
repair.creates: Opens a repair of the garment, with the case's problem: it waits for the goods, or starts now when the customer brought them.

RETURN.title: Return the goods
RETURN.creates: Opens an authorised return (RMA) of the garment: the dock receives it, then each line is decided.

REMAKE.title: Remake
REMAKE.creates: Opens a return with the remake asked: the garment is made again once the line is decided Remake.

CREDIT.title: Credit
CREDIT.creates: Opens a return for a credit: credited without the goods (a yes may be asked) or once they arrive.

repair.title: Make a repair from {number}
repair.problemHint: The case's words; a repair holds 2000 characters.
repair.received: The customer brought the garment now

title.CREDIT: Open a return for a credit from {number}

done.REMAKE: Return {number} opened with the remake asked, and linked.
done.CREDIT: Return {number} opened for a credit, and linked.

next.RETURN: Next: the dock receives the goods, then the office decides each line.
next.REMAKE: Next: the garment is made again once the line is decided Remake.
next.CREDIT: Next: credit it on the return, without the goods or once they arrive.

return.line: One piece: the garment {serial}, as it left on {number}.
return.fit: What is wrong with the fit

held.noShipment: The garment did not leave on a shipment we know: open the return from Returns & repairs with its lines.
held.fit: Say what is wrong with the fit.

move.subtitle: {from} → {to}
move.reasonHint: Closed without a resolution: say why.
move.reasonOptional: Optional: resolved cases close without a reason.
move.mailGoes: A status mail goes to {to}, in their language.
move.mailNoContact: This case tells the customer, but its contact has no e-mail: no mail goes.
move.mailWhat: It says the case number and where the case is now; never the problem, the resolution, the reasons or an amount.
move.notTold: The customer is not told: status mails are off for this case (Case tab).
move.closeLinks_one: {count} record is linked: it stays as it is.
move.closeLinks_other: {count} records are linked: they stay as they are.
move.mailSent: The customer was told: a mail to {to}.

mailNotSent.NO_CONTACT_EMAIL: No mail went: the case's contact has no e-mail.
mailNotSent.NOT_SENT: No mail went: the address is blocked or there is no sending address.

record.offline: Offline: the last copy, with its time. Changes wait.
record.stale: This case changed at {time} while you were working on it.

mails.title: Status-change mails sent to the customer
mails.on: This case tells the customer at each status change: mails to {to}.
mails.onNoContact: This case tells the customer, but its contact has no e-mail.
mails.off: This case does not tell the customer (Case tab › Tell the customer).

field.contactId: The contact (an active contact of this customer)
field.ownerId: The owner (someone whose role follows up these cases)
field.notifyCustomer: Tell the customer (needs a contact with an e-mail)
field.recordId: The record (of this company and customer)
field.lines: The lines that come back (the garment did not leave on a shipment we know)
field.fit: What is wrong with the fit

warning.cover: Check the cover: a guarantee ended, or the customer is not a consumer we sold to.
warning.decision: A refusal while the legal guarantee runs needs a reason the customer can check.
warning.deliveredOn: Check the delivery day: our records give none, or the batch went out on several days.
warning.serial: Check the serial: it was made for another customer, or another case is open for it.
warning.to: Linked repairs or returns are still open.
warning.notifyCustomer: The status mail did not go.
warning.lines: Check the lines that come back.
warning.other: The factory added a note: check the case.
